brief:
Hamas called on Arab and Muslim populations and free people worldwide to designate Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, and coming days as occasions for international solidarity with Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The movement urged demonstrations and action against the blockade of the territory.

The appeal aims to mobilize sustained grassroots pressure through coordinated global activism in response to the siege conditions in Gaza.

title: Hamas calls for global solidarity movement against Gaza blockade
